title: setSyntheticAssetsInfo does not bump configVersion, defeating the stale-config batch guard
root_cause: setSyntheticAssetsInfo (risk segments, oracle signers, quorum) has its incrConfigVersionInternal() commented out, so the MultiTransactionProcessor stale-config guard never fires for these changes.
out_of_scope_risks: relies on trusted operator/admin behavior (program trust model dependent)

severity_justification.worst_case: Risk/oracle config changes apply to already-signed batches without protection.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Admin-triggered; undermines a built-in safety mechanism.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: L2: record configVersion (=2); setSyntheticAssetsInfo (change risk segment) => version unchanged; control setMaxFundingRate => version increments to 3
L3: user batch carrying stale configVersion=2 -> processMultiTransactions ACCEPTS it after setSyntheticAssetsInfo (guard never fires)
L3 contrast: after the version-bumping setMaxFundingRate, the SAME stale batch is REJECTED ('config version mismatch')

state_transition.before: configVersion = V (=2); stale-config guard would protect in-flight batches
state_transition.after: configVersion still V after risk-param change (should be V+1); stale batch carrying V executes under the new risk params unguarded

asset_delta: In-flight user txs execute under changed risk/oracle params without the version-mismatch protection (proven: stale batch accepted post-change, rejected after a normal version-bumping change).
false_positive_risks: severity/scope depend on the official program trust model
invalidating_conditions: program may treat operator/admin actions as out of scope

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: guard relies on the version being bumped; this path skips the bump

assumptions: none profile-specific: the configVersion guard is in core MultiTransactionProcessor and is live on EVERY profile (perp/spot/predict), not perp-gated
triager_summary: setSyntheticAssetsInfo does not bump configVersion, defeating the stale-config batch guard — PoC passing (L2: version unchanged after the risk change vs +1 for setMaxFundingRate; L3: a stale-version batch is accepted after setSyntheticAssetsInfo but rejected after a version-bumping change). Core guard — live on all profiles.
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors (`setSyntheticAssetsInfo` does not bump `configVersion`; signature/cache validation keyed on the version can pass against stale config)
